info.name: Admission CRM API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection with sample inputs and endpoints for the Admission CRM Laravel API (v1). Includes Auth, Sessions, Courses, Batches, Admissions, Attendance, Leads, Users, and Roles & Permissions.

request.description: Authenticate user credentials and receive JWT access token. The token is automatically saved to the collection variable `{{token}}`.
Get current logged-in user profile with assigned role and permissions.
Update password for the current authenticated user.
Invalidate current JWT session token.

Fetch the currently active/primary institutional academic session.

request.description: Update attributes of an existing academic session.
Change session status: 1=Upcoming, 2=Active, 3=Completed, 4=Archived.
Set this academic session as the default active institutional session and unmark previous ones.
List all cohorts / batches scheduled under this academic session.
Delete an academic session record.

Delete a batch record.
